# Codezilla Teams

Codezilla Teams is an Employer of Record (EOR) and Contractor of Record service that lets foreign companies (US/UK/EU) legally hire employees in India without setting up an Indian subsidiary. Codezilla Global Technologies Pvt. Ltd. becomes the legal employer, handling payroll, TDS, PF/ESIC, statutory compliance, and labor liability, while the client company retains day-to-day management of the employee.

## Key Facts
- Flat pricing: -/employee/month for EOR, /month for Contractor of Record.
- Zero setup fees.
-  subsidiary transition fee.
- Onboarding completed in 3 business days.
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Certified.
- SOC 2 Type II Compliant.
- 100% Indian Labor Compliant (EPFO, ESIC, TDS, labor laws).
- Headquartered in Indore (MP, India) with a London (UK) office.
